scene.title: scene
scene.description:
A loom scene file (`docs/architecture.md` section 10). The file is RON;
this schema describes the same data as JSON: a RON tuple such as
`(1.0, 2.0, 3.0)` is a fixed-length array; an optional field may be left
out, and when given is written bare in RON (`mesh: Cube`, not
`mesh: Some(Cube)`); an enum such as `mesh` is serde's externally tagged
form: a unit variant is its name (`"Cube"`), a variant with fields an
object with one key (`{"Capsule": {"radius": 0.35, "height": 1.8}}`).
Loading checks more than the structure: the rules are in the field
descriptions.

ambient.description: Ambient light, linear RGB, each component from 0 to 1.

camera.description:
Path of the active camera node: names joined by "/" from a root
node. The node needs a camera component.

game.description:
Which game runs the scene, e.g. "souls" or "rogue"; `loom run` picks
the game by it. Not empty.

nodes.description: The root nodes, in drawing and checking order.

CameraDesc.description: A camera: `near` and `far` in meters, `0 < near < far`.

far.description: Meters to the far clipping plane.

fov_y.description:
Perspective: vertical field of view in degrees, between 0 and 180.
Exactly one of `fov_y` and `ortho` is given.

near.description: Meters to the near clipping plane.

CharacterDesc.description: Makes the node the character the game moves.

ColliderKind.description: Static collision shapes, sized and placed by the node's transform.

oneOf.description: Unit cube like `mesh: Cube`.

LightDesc.description: A directional light, shining along the node's -Z axis.

color.description: Linear RGB, each component from 0 to 1.

MeshKind.description: Mesh shapes. The first three are unit sized; size them with `scale`.

oneOf.description: Edge 1, centered at the origin.
1x1 on the XZ plane, facing +Y.
Diameter 1, centered at the origin.

A cylinder along Y capped by two half spheres. `height` includes the
caps; the origin is at the bottom, so it spans y in `[0, height]`.
Requires `radius > 0` and `height >= 2 * radius`.

NodeDesc.description: A scene node. Every number must be finite.

camera.description: Makes the node a camera, looking along its -Z axis.

character.description: The scene's one character, if any.

children.description: Child nodes, placed relative to this one.

collider.description:
A static collision shape. Not on the character's node; the node may
only rotate around Y (rotation x and z 0, no look_at), and its
ancestors only translate.

color.description:
The mesh color, linear RGB, each component from 0 to 1. Default
(0.8, 0.8, 0.8).

light.description: The scene's one light, if any.

look_at.description:
A point, in the parent's space, that the node's -Z axis turns to.
Not the node's own position, and not straight above or below it.

orbit_camera.description: The scene's one orbit camera, if any: on a node with a camera.

position.description: Local position in meters, relative to the parent. Default (0, 0, 0).

props.description:
Numbers for the game to interpret, as `(name, value)` pairs in file
order: names match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$, each given once, values
finite. Which names a game knows, and their rules, are under
`games.<game>.props`. A list, not a map: ron silently keeps the last
of two duplicate map keys.

rotation.description: YXZ Euler angles in degrees. Not together with `look_at`.

OrbitCameraDesc.description: A camera that orbits the character, as in Dark Souls.

collision_radius.description:
Radius of the camera's collision sphere, in meters:
`0 < collision_radius < pivot_height`.

distance.description: Meters from the pivot, greater than 0.

pitch.description:
Starting angle in degrees, between `pitch_min` and `pitch_max`;
positive looks up.

pivot_height.description: Meters above the character's feet the camera orbits around.

return_speed.description:
Meters per second the camera moves back out once unblocked, greater
than 0.

target.description: Path (from a root) of the node with the `character` component.

height.description:
World length the view covers vertically, greater than 0; the width
follows the aspect ratio.

SpriteDesc.description: A sprite: one tag of an Aseprite sheet, drawn on the node's XY plane.

alternates.description:
Other tags of the sheet the game may switch the sprite to while it
runs: each once, and not `tag`.

sheet.description:
Path of an Aseprite json-array sprite sheet, relative to the
working directory. Not empty.

tag.description: The tag shown, one of the sheet's. Not empty.

TilemapDesc.description:
A tile map: rows of characters, each drawing a tag of an Aseprite
sheet, one cell a unit square on the node's XY plane.

legend.description: Which tag each map character draws; each character once.

rows.description:
One string per row, top row first; one character per cell, every
character in the legend. At least one row, all of the same length,
at least 1.

sheet.description:
Path of an Aseprite json-array sprite sheet, relative to the
working directory. Not empty.

state_dump.title: StateDump
state_dump.description:
Generic over the game state only so that `loom schema` can describe
each game's dump from this same type (`docs/architecture.md` section 17).

actions.description: Actions active in the last tick, sorted by name.

axes.description: Every mapped axis with its value in the last tick, sorted by name.

nodes.description: Local transform of every scene node, keyed by path (sorted).

tick.description: Ticks run since the scene was loaded.

GameState.description: The game state in the state dump (`game`).

messages.description: Every message so far, oldest first.

turn.description: Turns taken so far: moves, attacks and waits.

zombies.description: In scene pre-order; dead ones stay, with `hp` 0, on their corpse.

Message.description: A line of the message log.

turn.description: The turn the message belongs to (after that turn was counted).

cell.description: `[column, row]`; row 0 is the map's top row.

Transform.description:
Local transform, relative to the parent node. Serializes as
`{"position": [x, y, z], "rotation": [x, y, z, w], "scale": [x, y, z]}`.

rotation.description: A unit quaternion `[x, y, z, w]`.

energy.description: Gained `speed` per turn, spent 100 per action.

trace_line.title: TraceLine
trace_line.description:
One line of a trace, the fields in this order. Generic only so that `loom schema` can describe a
game's lines from this same type (`docs/architecture.md` section 17).

events.description: The events that tick emitted, in order.

state.description: The state dump after the tick.

tick.description: The tick the line is about: its state is after that tick ran.

Event.description:
One event of a tick, for traces and `loom serve`'s `step`
(`docs/architecture.md` section 15, "事件"); serialized as an object
whose first field is `type`.

oneOf.description:
The player bumped into a zombie, or a zombie bit the player: one
per `You hit`, `You kill` or `bites you` message.

hp.description: The target's hp after the hit.

target.description: The node path of the one hit.

props.name: heavy_arc

props.name: swing_high
props.description: Above the target's feet: the top of that band.

props.name: attack_damage
props.description: Health a light hit takes off.

props.name: heavy_damage

props.name: attack_impact

props.name: heavy_impact

props.description: Makes the node a lock-on target, locked on this far above its position.

props.name: hurt_height
props.description: With hurt_radius: the height of the cylinder, from the node's position up.

props.name: enemy_swing_low

props.name: enemy_swing_high

props.name: sweep_damage

props.name: sweep_track_speed

props.name: combo_hits

props.name: combo_gap_ticks

requires: hurt_radius and hurt_height: both or neither
poise, stagger_ticks, poise_reset_ticks, revive_ticks: need hp
swing_impact, swing_startup_ticks, swing_active_ticks, swing_recovery_ticks, swing_reach, swing_arc, swing_low, swing_high: need swing_damage
every enemy_*, sweep_*, cleave_*, lunge_* and combo_* prop but enemy_speed: needs enemy_speed
constraints: lock-on targets, hurtboxes and swingers are root nodes, and not the camera
a hurtbox with hp: its child named hp_bar, if any, needs a mesh
a swinger or an enemy: its child named arm, if any, needs a mesh
an enemy (a node with enemy_speed): <move>_min_range <= <move>_max_range for sweep, cleave, lunge and combo
an enemy needs hurt_radius, hurt_height, hp and lock_height, is not a swinger, and is a root node other than the camera
an enemy: enemy_speed / 60 and lunge_distance / lunge_active_ticks are less than hurt_radius
an enemy has no collider in its subtree

state_dump.title: StateDump
state_dump.description:
Generic over the game state only so that `loom schema` can describe
each game's dump from this same type (`docs/architecture.md` section 17).

actions.description: Actions active in the last tick, sorted by name.

axes.description: Every mapped axis with its value in the last tick, sorted by name.

nodes.description: Local transform of every scene node, keyed by path (sorted).

tick.description: Ticks run since the scene was loaded.

Action.description: What the character is doing; serialized in lower case.

oneOf.description: A light attack.
A heavy attack.

AttackPhase.description: The part of an attack; serialized in lower case.

Buffered.description:
An action pressed during an attack, to start once it is over;
serialized in lower case.

oneOf.description: The roll key: a roll, or a backstep without a direction.

distance.description:
Meters from the pivot to the camera: the orbit distance, or less
while something is in the way.

Condition.description:
Whether a hurtbox with health stands, reels or lies dead; serialized in
lower case.

oneOf.description: Staggered: the impacts added up past its poise.

EnemyCondition.description: What an enemy is doing; serialized in snake case.

oneOf.description: Standing, or turning on the spot.
Walking up to the character.
Doing a move.
Resting after a move.
Staggered: its hurtbox's health says so.
Lying dead: its hurtbox's health says so.

EnemyState.description: An enemy in the state dump (`game.enemies`).

facing.description: Heading in radians around +Y, in `[-π, π)`; 0 faces -Z.

hit.description:
Which cut of a combo, from 1; 0 for the other moves and outside
`attack`.

move_tick.description: Which tick of the move, from 1; 0 outside `attack`.

phase.description:
The part of the move; the wait between two cuts of a combo is
`startup`. `None` outside `attack`.

rng.description: The state of its random numbers.

GameState.description: The game state in the state dump (`game`).

lock.description: The path of the locked-on target; `None` when not locked on.

HealthState.description: A hurtbox's health in the state dump (`game.hurtboxes[i].health`).

impact.description: Impacts added up since the last stagger or reset.

impact_wait.description: Ticks left before `impact` goes back to 0; 0 when not waiting.

state_ticks.description: Ticks left of the stagger or of death; 0 while `Ok`.

HurtboxState.description: A hurtbox in the state dump (`game.hurtboxes`).

last_hit.description: The latest hit; `None` before the first.

combo.description: The attack's `combo` (0 for a heavy attack).

tick.description: The tick it happened on, as in the state dump's `tick`.

MoveKind.description: One of the moves every enemy has; serialized in lower case.

oneOf.description: A wide horizontal swing.
A narrow, far-reaching swing.
A charge forward, swinging on the way.
Several cuts in a row, every other one left to right.

by.description: The path of the swinger that hit.

tick.description: The tick it happened on, as in the state dump's `tick`.

action_tick.description:
Which tick of a roll, backstep or attack this is, from 1; 0
otherwise.

attack_phase.description: The part of the attack running; `None` outside attacks.

buffered.description: The action to start once the running attack is over.

combo.description: Which light attack of a combo this is, from 1; 0 otherwise.

facing.description: Heading in radians around +Y, in `[-π, π)`; 0 faces -Z.

hits.description: Times a swinger hit the character since loading.

invulnerable.description:
Inside the invulnerability window of a roll or backstep: swings
miss.

last_hit.description: The latest hit on the character; `None` before the first.

position.description: Feet position in meters; serialized as `[x, y, z]`.

stamina_wait.description: Ticks left before stamina starts coming back.

SwingerState.description: A swinger in the state dump (`game.swingers`).

swing_tick.description:
Which tick of the round, from 1 to its length; 0 while staggered or
dead.

Transform.description:
Local transform, relative to the parent node. Serializes as
`{"position": [x, y, z], "rotation": [x, y, z, w], "scale": [x, y, z]}`.

rotation.description: A unit quaternion `[x, y, z, w]`.

trace_line.title: TraceLine
trace_line.description:
One line of a trace, the fields in this order. Generic only so that `loom schema` can describe a
game's lines from this same type (`docs/architecture.md` section 17).

events.description: The events that tick emitted, in order.

state.description: The state dump after the tick.

tick.description: The tick the line is about: its state is after that tick ran.

Action.description: What the character is doing; serialized in lower case.

oneOf.description: A light attack.
A heavy attack.

AttackPhase.description: The part of an attack; serialized in lower case.

Buffered.description:
An action pressed during an attack, to start once it is over;
serialized in lower case.

oneOf.description: The roll key: a roll, or a backstep without a direction.

distance.description:
Meters from the pivot to the camera: the orbit distance, or less
while something is in the way.

Condition.description:
Whether a hurtbox with health stands, reels or lies dead; serialized in
lower case.

oneOf.description: Staggered: the impacts added up past its poise.

DropReason.description: Why a press had no effect; when several apply, the first in this order.

oneOf.description: Rolling or backstepping.
In an attack's startup.
A press of higher priority (or the buffered action) took effect.
The lock key found nothing to lock on to.
Ran its ticks, or the sprint stopped.
Staggered or killed.

EnemyCondition.description: What an enemy is doing; serialized in snake case.

oneOf.description: Standing, or turning on the spot.
Walking up to the character.
Doing a move.
Resting after a move.
Staggered: its hurtbox's health says so.
Lying dead: its hurtbox's health says so.

EnemyState.description: An enemy in the state dump (`game.enemies`).

facing.description: Heading in radians around +Y, in `[-π, π)`; 0 faces -Z.

hit.description:
Which cut of a combo, from 1; 0 for the other moves and outside
`attack`.

move_tick.description: Which tick of the move, from 1; 0 outside `attack`.

phase.description:
The part of the move; the wait between two cuts of a combo is
`startup`. `None` outside `attack`.

rng.description: The state of its random numbers.

Event.description: One event; serialized as an object whose first field is `type`.

oneOf.description: The character hit a hurtbox, or a swinger hit the character.

by.description: The character's node path, or the swinger's.

damage.description: `None` when the target has no health.

hp.description: The target's health after the hit; `None` without health.

target.description: The hurtbox's path, or the character's.

oneOf.description: A swinger's slice touched the character while invulnerable.

action_tick.description: Which tick of the roll or backstep, from 1.

oneOf.description: A press that had no effect at all.

buffered.description: Only for `NoStamina`: the dropped input was the buffered one.

oneOf.description: A press replaced the buffered action.
The character started an action.

combo.description: Which light attack of a combo, from 1; 0 for other actions.

oneOf.description: The character's action ended, back to idle.
The lock-on target changed.

target.description: The new target's node path; `None` when let go of.

oneOf.description: A hurtbox came back to life (step 0b).
The character came back to life at its spawn point (step 0b).
An enemy chose a move (step 5c), before that move's first tick.

candidates.description: The moves it chose from, in their order.

GameState.description: The game state in the state dump (`game`).

lock.description: The path of the locked-on target; `None` when not locked on.

HealthState.description: A hurtbox's health in the state dump (`game.hurtboxes[i].health`).

impact.description: Impacts added up since the last stagger or reset.

impact_wait.description: Ticks left before `impact` goes back to 0; 0 when not waiting.

state_ticks.description: Ticks left of the stagger or of death; 0 while `Ok`.

HitAttack.description:
What hit: the character's light or heavy attack, a swinger, or an
enemy's move.

HurtboxState.description: A hurtbox in the state dump (`game.hurtboxes`).

last_hit.description: The latest hit; `None` before the first.

Input.description: A pressed input: the roll key's tap, or the lock key.

combo.description: The attack's `combo` (0 for a heavy attack).

tick.description: The tick it happened on, as in the state dump's `tick`.

oneOf.description: The lock key locked on or let go.
A sideways flick switched targets.
The character died.

MoveKind.description: One of the moves every enemy has; serialized in lower case.

oneOf.description: A wide horizontal swing.
A narrow, far-reaching swing.
A charge forward, swinging on the way.
Several cuts in a row, every other one left to right.

Outcome.description: What a hit did to the target.

oneOf.description: Neither of the others (always, without health).
Staggered it, or staggered it again.

by.description: The path of the swinger that hit.

tick.description: The tick it happened on, as in the state dump's `tick`.

action_tick.description:
Which tick of a roll, backstep or attack this is, from 1; 0
otherwise.

attack_phase.description: The part of the attack running; `None` outside attacks.

buffered.description: The action to start once the running attack is over.

combo.description: Which light attack of a combo this is, from 1; 0 otherwise.

facing.description: Heading in radians around +Y, in `[-π, π)`; 0 faces -Z.

hits.description: Times a swinger hit the character since loading.

invulnerable.description:
Inside the invulnerability window of a roll or backstep: swings
miss.

last_hit.description: The latest hit on the character; `None` before the first.

position.description: Feet position in meters; serialized as `[x, y, z]`.

stamina_wait.description: Ticks left before stamina starts coming back.

StateDump.description:
Generic over the game state only so that `loom schema` can describe
each game's dump from this same type (`docs/architecture.md` section 17).

actions.description: Actions active in the last tick, sorted by name.

axes.description: Every mapped axis with its value in the last tick, sorted by name.

nodes.description: Local transform of every scene node, keyed by path (sorted).

tick.description: Ticks run since the scene was loaded.

SwingerState.description: A swinger in the state dump (`game.swingers`).

swing_tick.description:
Which tick of the round, from 1 to its length; 0 while staggered or
dead.

Transform.description:
Local transform, relative to the parent node. Serializes as
`{"position": [x, y, z], "rotation": [x, y, z, w], "scale": [x, y, z]}`.

rotation.description: A unit quaternion `[x, y, z, w]`.
